ambient_events: The junction is swept clear to the tile, and there is lime dust in the corners.
A tin can hangs from a wire across the north pipe, low enough to catch a knee in the dark.
Footsteps somewhere ahead stop when you stop. After a moment, they go on.
description: A run of domestic storm line under Kessler Street, the walls streaked with a century of household runoff. Somewhere a broken pipe drips with idiot patience.
name: Drain Junction
